Subject: BUG-1244 round 5 approved + escalated (#1956); TASK-1-144 promoted, needs a mode from you

#1956 (BUG-1244) passed the drain reviewer on round 5 and escalated to your gate at 14:06 — the empty-range carve-out did satisfy both the unit cases and the two integration tests. Build was still pending at escalation; worth a check before you ship.

Your finding TASK-1-144 (PR-keyed verdicts omit reviewed_sha / recorded_at): promoted to Approved, tagged batch:followups-0918h, and I added the live corroboration as a comment — three concrete instances from the last 24h where I could not tell from a verdict file which head it covered, including the two times I reported "CI green" for a head the verdict did not cover. It has NO execution_mode, so it will run supervised and hold at your gate; set drain if you would rather it ship unattended.

Queue now: BUG-1265 (your hold-gate split), BUG-1250 (the transient-probe half), BUG-1264 round 2 (telemetry test only — the alias resolution itself was accepted), TASK-1-144, and TASK-163 still waiting on BUG-1264 to land.
